nodes.name: Geospatial Sensors
nodes.description: Pure coordinate, GNSS filtering, PDR, map matching, image resampling, and smoother atoms.

nodes.name: lla_to_ecef
nodes.description: Convert WGS84 latitude, longitude, and altitude arrays to ECEF coordinates.
nodes.type_signature: (lat: NDArray[np.float64], lon: NDArray[np.float64], alt: NDArray[np.float64]) -> tuple[NDArray[np.float64], NDArray[np.float64], NDArray[np.float64]]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Converts geodetic coordinates to geocentric Cartesian coordinates using element-wise trigonometric and algebraic operations on n-element input arrays.

nodes.name: ecef_to_lla
nodes.description: Convert ECEF coordinate arrays to WGS84 latitude, longitude, and altitude.
nodes.type_signature: (x: NDArray[np.float64], y: NDArray[np.float64], z: NDArray[np.float64]) -> tuple[NDArray[np.float64], NDArray[np.float64], NDArray[np.float64]]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computes WGS84 coordinates from Cartesian ECEF coordinates via vectorized trigonometric, root, and division operations scaling linearly with the array size n.

nodes.name: ecef_to_enu
nodes.description: Project ECEF coordinates into a local east-north-up tangent plane.
nodes.type_signature: (x: NDArray[np.float64], y: NDArray[np.float64], z: NDArray[np.float64], ref_lat: float, ref_lon: float, ref_alt: float) -> tuple[NDArray[np.float64], NDArray[np.float64], NDArray[np.float64]]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Projects ECEF coordinates onto a local tangent plane using an O(1) reference point conversion followed by O(n) element-wise vector translations and rotations.

nodes.name: correct_clock_bias
nodes.description: Correct GNSS pseudoranges for receiver and satellite clock bias.
nodes.type_signature: (pseudoranges: NDArray[np.float64], sat_clock_bias: NDArray[np.float64], rx_clock_bias: NDArray[np.float64]) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Applies receiver and satellite clock bias corrections in a single element-wise linear pass over the n-element input arrays.

nodes.name: filter_by_cn0
nodes.description: Mask GNSS measurements whose C/N0 is below a threshold.
nodes.type_signature: (measurements: NDArray[np.float64], cn0: NDArray[np.float64], threshold: float) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Evaluates a carrier-to-noise density threshold to filter GNSS measurements in a single vectorized pass over the n-element input arrays.

nodes.name: filter_multipath
nodes.description: Mask measurements whose multipath indicator exceeds a threshold.
nodes.type_signature: (measurements: NDArray[np.float64], multipath_indicator: NDArray[np.float64], threshold: float) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Filters out multipath-affected measurements by performing element-wise absolute value and comparison operations across n-element arrays.

nodes.name: detect_steps
nodes.description: Detect pedestrian step events as constrained acceleration peaks.
nodes.type_signature: (accel_magnitude: NDArray[np.float64], threshold: float, prominence: float, min_distance: int) -> NDArray[np.int64]

common_patterns.description: Detect steps from accelerometer, estimate lengths, compute positions
common_patterns.when: Stage describes pedestrian dead reckoning from IMU

nodes.complexity_reasoning: Uses peak-finding algorithms that perform a linear scan and local candidate validation over the n-element accelerometer magnitude array.

nodes.name: estimate_step_length_weinberg
nodes.description: Estimate stride length from vertical acceleration range per step cycle.
nodes.type_signature: (accel_z: NDArray[np.float64], step_indices: NDArray[np.int64], k_constant: float) -> NDArray[np.float64]

common_patterns.description: Detect steps from accelerometer, estimate lengths, compute positions
common_patterns.when: Stage describes pedestrian dead reckoning from IMU

nodes.complexity_reasoning: Iterates through step cycles and computes max/min values over adjacent segments that partition the n-element acceleration array, leading to a linear scan overall.

nodes.name: integrate_heading
nodes.description: Integrate z-axis angular velocity into heading.
nodes.type_signature: (gyro_z: NDArray[np.float64], dt: float, initial_heading: float = 0.0) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computes cumulative trapezoidal integration using a linear time prefix-sum (cumsum) over the n-element angular rate array.

nodes.name: pdr_position_update
nodes.description: Accumulate a two-dimensional PDR path from step lengths and headings.
nodes.type_signature: (step_lengths: NDArray[np.float64], headings: NDArray[np.float64], initial_position: tuple[float, float]) -> NDArray[np.float64]

common_patterns.description: Detect steps from accelerometer, estimate lengths, compute positions
common_patterns.when: Stage describes pedestrian dead reckoning from IMU

nodes.complexity_reasoning: Reconstructs the 2D path by performing element-wise trigonometric conversions and a cumulative sum over n-element step lists.

nodes.name: snap_to_nearest
nodes.description: Project trajectory points to nearest valid map/grid nodes.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Building a k-d tree from M grid nodes takes O(M log M) time and O(M) space, while querying nearest neighbors for N trajectory points takes O(N log M) time and O(N) space.

nodes.name: resample_to_gsd
nodes.description: Resample a spatial image to a target ground sampling distance.
nodes.type_signature: (image: NDArray[np.float64], current_gsd: float, target_gsd: float) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Resampling uses bilinear interpolation to map each pixel of the scaled output image, requiring time and space proportional to the output spatial dimensions.

nodes.name: rts_smooth
nodes.description: Run a fixed-interval Rauch-Tung-Striebel smoother over filter histories.
nodes.type_signature: (filtered_states: NDArray[np.float64], filtered_covs: NDArray[np.float64], predicted_states: NDArray[np.float64], predicted_covs: NDArray[np.float64], transition_matrices: NDArray[np.float64]) -> tuple[NDArray[np.float64], NDArray[np.float64]]

common_patterns.description: Full EKF cycle with RTS backward smoother
common_patterns.when: Stage describes EKF with smoothing or forward-backward filtering

nodes.complexity_reasoning: Iterates backward over T time steps, performing O(D^3) matrix multiplication and pseudo-inverse operations at each step, and storing state history of size T x D and covariance history of size T x D x D.

nodes.name: apply_asymmetric_bias_correction
nodes.description: Scale selected predictions by a positive asymmetric-loss correction factor.
nodes.type_signature: (predictions: NDArray[np.float64], multiplier: float, condition_mask: NDArray[np.bool_]) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Applies an asymmetric multiplier to selected predictions based on a boolean mask in a single element-wise pass over the n-element array.
